definitions.explanation: A perfectly straight path without curves or bends.
Moving or heading directly toward a goal without detours.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}が{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The road continues in a straight line.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{目標|もくひょう}に{向|む}かって{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: He headed straight for his goal.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わったら{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}る。
examples.english: When work is over, I head straight home.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{一|いっ} (one/single) + {直線|ちょくせん} (straight line)

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{続|つづ}く (to continue in a straight line)
・{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{進|すす}む (to proceed directly)
・{一直線|いっちょくせん}に{向|む}かう (to head straight toward)

FIGURATIVE USE:
Often used metaphorically to describe pursuing a goal without distraction or deviation.

SIMILAR:
・まっすぐ - straight, directly
・{直行|ちょっこう} - going directly
